statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House of Representatives seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls published by 2026-12-18 award at least 218 House seats to Democratic candidates in the general election held on 2026-11-03; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win fewer than 218 House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The functions of the person serving as French Prime Minister on 2026-10-24 are formally ended by presidential decree, following resignation or a successful censure motion, between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Journal Officiel publishes a decree dated between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-31 ending the functions of the person who was French Prime Minister on 2026-10-24.
failure_condition: The President does not end the functions of the person who was French Prime Minister on 2026-10-24 at any point between 2026-10-26 and 2026-12-31.
